name: Elias Hart
life: “I still remember hosting a pupil who missed supper to practice.” On Monday, near the bank steps, Elias takes a few minutes to read the public notices, especially the ones written in a hurry.
voice: I found a host family. They have an empty room and a curfew the winner's evening job can't meet.
appearance: Elias has full cheeks and a mouth that pulls slightly to one side. Look for a long plait tucked inside the collar. On an ordinary day, the familiar outfit is a striped cotton shirt with a comb in a sleeve sewn into the lining. In conversation Elias starts to lift a hand, then waits to be invited to speak.
personality: Elias has an appetite for a good argument about little things and works hard to keep a serious disagreement from being turned into entertainment.
agenda: To negotiate an evening curfew a working pupil can keep.
family: Terry Lau is Elias’s older cousin. Elias saves a place. Terry chooses whether to use it. The invitation means something because declining it has never ended the friendship between their households. Asked about *The guarantee*, Terry says, “I declined to be a guarantor for my own child.”
connections: Benedict Lund. A proposed host family's curfew has to work on the far less glamorous February journeys too.
